summary: Cresud Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting an interest payment on its Series XLVIII fixed-rate notes. The company will pay the second installment of interest on July 13, 2026, covering the period from January 11, 2026, to July 11, 2026. The outstanding capital is USD 46,656,188, with an annual nominal interest rate of 8.00%, resulting in a payment of USD 1,731,894.80. Payment agent is Caja de Valores S.A. This is a routine debt service filing, not a special situation.
